mapper.select: /* [신청관리 > OCR서식등록신청] - selectFormApplDetail */ SELECT A.APPC_ID AS applId, A.LEFRM_NM AS formNm, U.EMP_KOR_FLNM AS applicantNm, A.PRGS_ST_CD AS procStatCd FROM ocuoc_lfapp_m A LEFT JOIN ocuoc_useri_m U ON U.EMPNO = A.APCT_ID WHERE A.APPC_ID = #{applId}

/* [신청관리 > OCR서식등록신청] - selectFormApplFldList */ SELECT FILD_ID AS fldId, IMG_ID AS imgId, UPRN_FILD_ID AS upFldId, ROW_NO AS rowNo, FILD_DV_CD AS fldTypeCd, RADR_DV_CD AS srcTypeCd, FILD_NM AS fldNm, FILD_VAL AS fldVal, FILD_DESC AS fldDesc, ESN_YN AS reqYn, VALDTN_RULE AS validRule, META_RULE AS metaRule, DATA_TYPE_CD AS dataTypeCd, DATA_LEN AS dataLen, MASK_YN AS maskYn, MASK_RANGE AS maskRange, DATA_CMPR_RULE AS dataCmprRule, META_CLSS AS metaClss, META_TYPE AS metaType, META_WORD AS metaWord, META_LNM AS metaLnm, META_PNM AS metaPnm FROM ocuoc_lfafl_l WHERE APPC_ID = #{applId} AND (FILD_VAL IS NOT NULL OR FILD_DV_CD = 'GROUP' OR VALDTN_RULE IS NOT NULL OR META_RULE IS NOT NULL OR FILD_DESC IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY FILD_ID ASC

mapper.insert: /* [신청관리 > OCR서식등록신청] - upsertFormApplWriteCntn */ MERGE INTO ocuoc_lfarc_l T USING ( SELECT #{applId} AS APPC_ID, #{srcTypeCd} AS RADR_DV_CD FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.APPC_ID = S.APPC_ID AND T.RADR_DV_CD = S.RADR_DV_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.FLIN_CNTN = #{writeCntn}, T.EDTR_ID = #{regId}, T.CHNG_DT = #{regDt} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (APPC_ID, RADR_DV_CD, FLIN_CNTN, RGSR_ID, REG_DT, EDTR_ID, CHNG_DT) VALUES (#{applId}, #{srcTypeCd}, #{writeCntn}, #{regId}, #{regDt}, #{regId}, #{regDt})
